# SemanticTrafficAwareness

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The capability of a routing system to infer traffic priorities and quality-of-service requirements from semantic descriptions of applications or data flows. Allows neuromorphic and in-network computing nodes to prioritize spike-like or event-driven traffic, improving real-time responsiveness and resource utilization.
